name: deutsche-bahn-data
what_it_holds: Historical Deutsche Bahn train schedule, delay (minutes late), cancellation (arrival/departure separately), and station data. Raw API responses (parquet-wrapped XML/JSON) and monthly processed parquet files (20 columns: station, train ID, planned/actual times, delay, cancellation flag) for ~100 largest stations Jul 2024-Nov 2025, then all German stations Nov 2025-present (with a known 2025-11 to 2026-07 API-outage gap). Repo git history was rewritten to drop large files; full data now published on Hugging Face. CC BY 4.0 (DB) data licence.
why_useful: German/European rail punctuality and cancellation-rate time series at near-daily granularity — a EU ground-travel supply/demand and disruption proxy (gap #10) and a possible cancellation-rate methodology analogue for the RNPL/cancellation thesis (gap #3), even though the underlying business (rail) differs from STR bookings.
size_hint: Monthly parquet files, ~100-all stations x daily train movements
last_activity: active as of the 2026 README reference
themes: Rail and ground travel: Amtrak ridership, SNCF/DB/Trenitalia open data, Eurostar, bus (FlixBus), rideshare datasets (Uber Movement), NYC TLC airport trips, Chicago taxi
